Locally served browser preview dependencies; no CDN/runtime download.
jszip 3.10.1: https://registry.npmjs.org/jszip/-/jszip-3.10.1.tgz
  dist/jszip.min.js; license in jszip.LICENSE (MIT or GPLv3).
docx-preview 0.3.7: https://registry.npmjs.org/docx-preview/-/docx-preview-0.3.7.tgz
  dist/docx-preview.min.js; license in docx-preview.LICENSE (Apache-2.0).
DOCX rendering occurs in a sandboxed iframe. Browser layout is approximate;
reference comparisons require user-checked source text.
